name: Remember the Flowers: Vendetta
source:
When Damion accidentally falls into the future, he finds himself amongst an independent organization to get his boyfriend back from the ones who took him away 300 years ago.

[From [url=https://fdfstudios.itch.io/rtf-vendetta]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当达米恩意外坠入未来时，他发现自己加入了一个独立组织，目的是从300年前带走他的人手中救回他的男朋友。

[来自[url=https://fdfstudios.itch.io/rtf-vendetta]Itch.io[/url]]
